is_anopheles.evidence: Mentions Anopheles malaria vectors including An. gambiae, An. arabiensis, An. maculatus, and An. minimus (page 7-8).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper is a meeting report and does not report genotyping for any of the target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable marker genotype counts, allele counts, or frequencies are presented.

african_field_population.evidence: No empirical field population mosquito genotype data from Africa are presented.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a meeting report summarizing discussions from a 1-day workshop held in Bangkok on December 1st 2014 (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary field collection location data linked to target marker genotypes are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field sampling date window linked to target marker genotypes is reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; no primary empirical sample genotyping reported.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are required as this is a non-eligible meeting report.

assessment.summary: This document is a meeting report summarizing a workshop held in Bangkok in December 2014 regarding challenges for malaria control, drug resistance, and vector control. It contains no primary empirical mosquito genotyping data for target resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary study (meeting report summarizing a workshop).
Does not report genotyping or extractable genotype data for target resistance markers.
